textbookText: vi. Diaphragm is a muscular partition that separates posterior abdominal cavity from anterior thoracic cavity. vii. Endoskeleton is thoroughly ossified, skull is dicondylic, with tympanic bulla and dentary. viii. They have complete alimentary canal terminating into anus. Teeth are heterodont, thecodont and diphyodont. ix. Respiration is always pulmonary. x. Heart is four chambered and absence of renal portal system. RBC non-nucleated. xi. Chief excretory organs are a pair of metanephric kidney and excretion is ureotelic. xii. Brain is highly developed with 12 pairs of cranial nerves. xiii. Sense organs are well developed; eye protected within eye lid, ear opening protected by pinna and middle ear with ear ossicles (malleus, incus and stapes) and inner ear consist of spiral cochlea. xiv. Sexes are separate with distinct sexual dimorphism where male has erectile copulatory organ called penis and testis within scrotum pouch, and eggs are small with little yolk. xv. Fertilization internal. They are all viviparous except some. Development is uterine in which foetus is attached to the wall of uterus of mother by placenta for nutrition and respiration. Embryonic membranes are amnion,chorian and allantois. Unique features Body covered by hair, sweat and sebaceous gland in skin, ear with pinna and three ear ossicles, dentition well developed, presence of diaphragm, mostly viviparous, mammary glands in female for breast feeding
